title: Closed A-to-cooperative-B pre-bind FD3 v3 (draft)
description: The fixed Machine launcher gives this exact four-field RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 frame on B FD3 before bind. Its encoded size is at most 32,768 bytes for this version only; the protected B FD3 limit stays 16,384 bytes. B opens the fixed root-owned installed A Ed25519 pin, decodes canonical unpadded base64url, verifies exact JCS/signature/purpose agent-bot/soul-cooperative-reservation/v3 for the primary and agent-bot/soul-cooperative-bridge-assignment/v3 for the detached B assignment, then joins detached reservation_sha256 to the exact primary envelope bytes and checks bridge launch, three endpoint parents, fixed argv, accounts, plan/start/expiry. FD3 carries no two-member policy rows, member selectors, owner ACP ticket or provider ingress. FD4 separately carries a fresh 32-byte A-private one-use HMAC key; FD5 separately reports B bind/relay status. After HMAC bind, B requests full A-signed two-member policy on that same H/B connection before arms or traffic. Missing/changed fields or stale authority refuse; no fallback to protected FD3.
